title: Alba
description:
This single-family T3 house project was conceived as a living space that is both elegant and functional, deeply connected to its natural surroundings. 

At the heart of the ground floor, the bespoke kitchen stands out as a central feature, combining aesthetics with everyday practicality. It is enhanced by a Calacatta marble table, whose natural veining brings character and refinement. The worktop supports, crafted in Stevenson birch, introduce a warm and authentic touch, creating a subtle balance between noble materials and organic textures. Upstairs, the night area hosts a master suite designed as a true cocoon. The bathroom, finished in microcement, offers a contemporary and minimalist atmosphere. A custom-designed piece of furniture serves both as storage and as a decorative element. 

The entire house was designed around a strong intention: to create generous spaces filled with natural light. The open volumes and carefully considered perspectives enhance this sense of spaciousness, while providing a calm and harmonious living environment.
